title: S1 AweWithBB V3.9 — fail-pattern report (30-minute contract)
question: Under the docs/RESEARCH_DEVELOPMENT_SPEC.md section 5 standard report contract, what do the fail-pattern, 30-minute timing, BB/DXY/MTF context views show for the current active S1 AweWithBB V3.9?
hypothesis: This is a full-coverage fail-pattern reproduction for the currently active strategy version, not a single hypothesis test; it exists as the V3.9 half of the RS-XAUUSD-20260727-005 gap report and as a deeper companion to the existing RS-XAUUSD-20260727-001 Macro/30m-slot study.

findings.title: normal_sl is now the dominant fail type
findings.detail: 104 of 197 losses (52.8%) are a clean normal_sl stop-out; immediate_loss dropped to 25.9% (51 trades) from V3.4's 30.9% — entries are less often wrong from the start.

findings.title: Counter-trend (4H bearish) underperformance is larger than in V3.4

findings.title: K-bar coverage improved but is still partial
findings.detail: 19/51 (37.3%) immediate_loss trades have overlapping 30m OHLCV+RSI price history, up from V3.4's 23.3%, but still not full-sample.

findings.title: Consistent with the adopted RS-XAUUSD-20260727-001 baseline
findings.detail: Overall n/WR/PF here (450 / 56.22% / 1.869) reproduce RS-XAUUSD-20260727-001 exactly, confirming this deeper report did not change the already-adopted S1 advisory-score evidence.
